cleanupFailurePolicy.readinessFailure: FAIL — 60s bounded timeout, no indefinite retry
cleanupFailurePolicy.migrationFailure: FAIL — non-zero exit or any reported pending migration after migrate deploy
cleanupFailurePolicy.productionLikeEndpointDetection: FAIL CLOSED, before any provisioning command runs
cleanupFailurePolicy.cleanupFailureAfterSuccessfulTests: FAIL the runtime job — reverses the original P2A design's warn-only rule
cleanupFailurePolicy.cleanupFailureAfterFailedTests: preserve the original test failure as primary, additionally and separately report the infrastructure cleanup failure — not conflated into one opaque message
cleanupFailurePolicy.localOrphanResource: non-zero exit plus an actionable cleanup command printed to the operator
cleanupFailurePolicy.ciOrphanResource: cleanup step must run with always/finally semantics (e.g. GitHub Actions if: always())
cleanupFailurePolicy.sweeper: defense-in-depth only, not the primary success criterion — role narrows now that per-run cleanup is fail-fatal
cleanupFailurePolicy.exceptionRationale: The task brief's stricter policy is adopted in full, with no carve-out. A flaky docker rm is expected to surface as a real, actionable failure rather than being absorbed silently — a silently-leaked container/database/bucket is itself a real problem (resource exhaustion, future-run collision risk) that deserves visibility, not suppression.

f1003p2ImplementationContract.title: F1-003-P2 — Disposable PostgreSQL and MinIO Provisioning and Collision Avoidance
filesExpectedToBeCreatedOrChanged: scripts/test-runtime/provision.ps1 (PowerShell-compatible local entry point; exact path a P2 implementation-time decision)
No .github/workflows/** file, unless P2's own task definition explicitly re-includes CI-workflow activation
No change required to server/package.json's existing script definitions; new profile-composition wrapper scripts may be added but must not rename/remove/reorder any existing script
f1003p2ImplementationContract.dynamicHostPortAllocation: Docker-assigned via -p 127.0.0.1::5432 / ::9000, discovered via docker port after bind — never pre-scan-then-bind
f1003p2ImplementationContract.collisionResistantIdentifiers: runKey derived from CI_RUN_ID/CI_RUN_ATTEMPT/process.pid/a fresh UUID; nmtest_<scopeTag>_<runKey> databases, nmtest-<scopeTag>-<runKey> buckets, nmtest-pg-<scopeTag>-<runKey>/nmtest-minio-<scopeTag>-<runKey> containers
f1003p2ImplementationContract.preImportDatabaseUrlConstruction: DATABASE_URL constructed and exported before any Prisma-dependent test file is imported; never hardcoded, never written to a committed .env file
f1003p2ImplementationContract.preImportMinioEnvConstruction: MINIO_ENDPOINT/MINIO_ACCESS_KEY/MINIO_SECRET_KEY constructed and exported before any storage-dependent test file is imported
f1003p2ImplementationContract.productionLikeEndpointGuards: hard-fail before any provisioning command runs, per productionEndpointGuardPolicy
f1003p2ImplementationContract.readinessTimeouts: 60s bounded for both Postgres (pg_isready) and MinIO (GET /minio/health/ready); fail on timeout, never indefinite retry
f1003p2ImplementationContract.migrationDeploySequence: npx prisma generate && npx prisma migrate deploy; assert exit 0 and zero reported pending migrations; exactly once per provisioned database, before any dependent test runs
f1003p2ImplementationContract.deterministicCleanup: per cleanupFailurePolicy (fail-fatal on cleanup failure, superseding the original P2A design's warn-only rule)
f1003p2ImplementationContract.signalInterruptionCleanup: PowerShell try/finally + Register-EngineEvent PowerShell.Exiting for local Windows; POSIX trap EXIT/INT/TERM for the Bash entry point; documented known-gap for a hard task-manager-kill on Windows
f1003p2ImplementationContract.staleResourceLabelsAndTtl: noramedi.disposable-runtime=true, noramedi.run-scope, noramedi.run-id, noramedi.created-at labels; 4-hour local/worktree TTL; no sweeper needed in CI
exactAggregateCommandsP2MustExecute: server:test:disposable-db (9 members) against a freshly-provisioned, freshly-migrated disposable Postgres
server:test:storage-integration (1 member) against the same disposable Postgres plus a freshly-provisioned disposable MinIO
Legacy server:test only if P2's own task definition explicitly includes making it runnable — silence is not an acceptable resolution, per F1-003-P1's own acceptance criterion

The 5 migration profiles (profile-1-empty-db-migrate-deploy, profile-2-previous-release-to-current-upgrade, profile-3-migration-idempotency-status, profile-4-application-test-execution-after-migration, profile-5-destructive-rollback-rehearsal [opt-in, non-default])
f1003p2ImplementationContract.exactPassFailEvidenceRequired: Real, reported pass/fail counts for server:test:disposable-db and server:test:storage-integration — not merely not_executed_dependency_blocked
f1003p2ImplementationContract.legacyServerTestExecutionRequiredInP2OrD: Not pre-decided by this contract — an explicit P2-time decision with two acceptable outcomes (provision now, or defer with a documented reason); P2's own evidence must state which was chosen and why
f1003p2ImplementationContract.exactMigrationScope: Forward-only prisma migrate deploy against a freshly disposable, empty database, applying the full current migration set (67+ directories as of this reconciliation's baseline); no new migration created by P2
f1003p2ImplementationContract.exactRollbackMethod: None automated. Profile 5 (destructive rollback rehearsal) is hand-authored, opt-in, non-default, mirrors F0-011-P2's methodology, and does not introduce new automated rollback tooling. R-070 remains open.
